briefs.title: Daily Public Equity
briefs.prompt: Produce a concise daily public-equity market briefing: overnight and pre-market moves in the major indices (S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow), a few notable single-name movers with the 'why', the key macro/economic headlines of the day, and a short 'what to watch' list. Keep it sharp, practical, and non-hype.

briefs.title: Daily DX Intel
briefs.prompt: Produce a daily developer-experience (DX) intelligence briefing: notable dev-tooling, platform, and framework releases or changes; emerging DX trends; anything affecting CI/CD, editors, AI coding tools, or productivity; and one concrete, actionable insight for a builder to try today.

briefs.title: Daily Overview
briefs.prompt: Produce a short, upbeat daily overview that ties the day together: the big theme, the top three priorities to focus on, one thing to be mindful of, and a motivating sign-off. Keep it brief.
